blocks.html: Acclaimed Brooklyn-born vocalist, producer, and multi-instrumentalist <strong>Dawin, will perform his</strong> global viral sensation <em>“Dessert” feat. </em><strong>Silentó</strong> and the rest of his party grooves at Robinsons Malls- Robinsons Galleria Ortigas activity area on February 29, 6PM and at Robinsons Metro East activity area on March 1, 6PM.
Robinsons Malls gives you three exciting ways to party upclose with Dawin-

Present a minimum P500 single-receipt transaction made at any retail outlet at Robinsons Galleria Ortigas (from February 26- February 29) and Robinsons Metro East (from February 26- March 1) at the designated entrance of the activity area and enter the venue for free;

Get yourself a Darwin EP album at Robinsons Galleria Ortigas on February 29 or Robinsons Metro East on March 1 which will entitle you to a free entrance to the venue plus CD signing at the end of the show;

Simply follow @RobinsonsMallsOfficial, @RobinsonsGalleriaOfficial, @RobMetroEast on Instagram; repost and share the <em>Dawin Live At Robinsons Malls </em>poster; include complete name, email and the hashtags: #MeetandGreetDawinatRobinsonMalls, #DawinLiveAtRobinsonsGalleria, #DawinLiveAtRobinsonsMetroEast; tag @RobinsonsMallsOfficial, @RobinsonsGalleriaOfficial, @RobMetroEast and add a friend; and be one of twenty lucky winners to see Dawin perform live.
For more information, follow Robinsons Malls in Instagram, Facebook and see posters and print ads for details. Per DTI-FTEB Permit No. 168, Series of 2016.
